about_the_game:
Supercars, Neon-lit Cities, Cyber-Grids and Endless Highways: Welcome to Neon Highways, Where the '80s Come Back to Life!

Neon Highways is a Synthwave / Retrowave inspired casual arcade racer that lets you cruise through the vibrant, neon-lit streets of the 80s.

The music and visual style of Synthwave, inspired by a retro-futuristic vision of the 1980s, evokes a nostalgic sense of a past that never truly existed, yet feels instantly familiar.

If you’re considering buying Neon Highways, please keep in mind that this is a simple, minimalist project from a solo indie developer, not a blockbuster with endless hours of content. Instead, it offers a short, simple but atmospheric road trip through a retro-futuristic world, where Retrowave, Synthwave, and Neon-Noir aesthetics merge with nostalgic synth melodies. With OutRun-like gameplay, you’ll race against the clock on an unforgettable journey through vibrant landscapes.

What’s waiting for you in Neon Highways?

  • 🏁 Unlock New Highways, Chase the Horizon!
    Cruise through neon-lit cityscapes, endless desert highways, and scenic ocean roads. Unlock up to 12 highways across 6 unique regions.

  • 🚗 Unlock Sleek Supercars!
    From classic-inspired speed machines to futuristic cruisers, unlock a small collection of stylish supercars as you progress.

  • 🎵 Synthwave Soundtrack, Pure Retro Vibes!
    Cruise through neon highways with a synthwave soundtrack that perfectly matches the vibe. Every track brings that classic 80s arcade feel to life.

  • 🎥 Authentic Retro Visual FX!
    We’ve taken care to make sure Neon Highways doesn’t just look retro, it feels retro. Unlock retro visual modes like CRT scanlines, subtle film grain, and VHS-style artifacts that bring the nostalgia of old-school arcades and TVs to life on your modern screen.

  • 🎮 Casual Racing, Pure Arcade Fun!
    Neon Highways brings a relaxing casual arcade racing experience built for pure cruising enjoyment. If you’re up for a challenge, switch to the Rush Hour Mode—where heavier traffic and tighter time limits create a true test of your reflexes that brings all the stress you could ask for!

Grab the wheel, hit the open road, and let the neon sun guide you through a world where the '80s never left.

🚨 Limited-Time Launch Discount! 🚨

Add Neon Highways to your Wishlist now to know when it launches, so you don’t miss out on the launch discount!

  • Processor: Quad-core Intel or AMD, 2.5 GHz
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 650 Ti, 2 GB | AMD Radeon R7 360, 2 GB
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: yes, definitely

  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 780, 3 GB | AMD Radeon R9 290X, 4 GB
  • Storage: 4 GB available space
  • Sound Card: yes, definitely
